versions.changelog:
- Initial release of run-options-forecast skill.
- Forecasts expected close range for stocks at option expiration using a Breeden-Litzenberger risk-neutral density model.
- Recommends ranked options strategies (spreads, iron condor, butterfly, straddle), including strikes, probability of profit, and reward-to-risk, tailored to the forecasted bands.
- Command-line interface for generating text or machine-readable forecasts; includes a dashboard for detailed analysis and visualization.
- Designed for easy setup and portability with clear troubleshooting support and minimal configuration required.
